metadata.title: DUO icosahedral level 3 — unit sphere (N=1280 cells)
metadata.description: DUO triangular icosahedral mesh at subdivision level 3 (1280 cells), unit sphere R=1. Used for Layer-C MMS time-integration convergence tests where the diffusion timescale R^2 must be O(1) so that t_final=0.001 produces a measurable solution change.
